summary: Implemented bounded local original admission, content-addressed immutable blobs and independently identified source revisions with verified inspection and no-replace publication.
API: parse_manifest(bytes); OriginalStore(path, fault=None).admit(approved_root, source), inspect(revision_id), close(); documented in docs/parallel/source-admission-api.md.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures only; no real corpus or hardware qualification.
Private operator-controlled local POSIX store and filesystem supporting hard links and directory fsync are required.
No parser, extraction, authentication, revocation, snapshot, source serving, legal approval, or MVP acceptance is claimed.
